items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then they had Jack Powell... He was a white drummer, tremendous. Jack Powell.

ctx.x: Yeah, so -- but he was one of the trick drummers. And then they had Jack Powell. I don't -- do you remember him? And they called it his Musical Kitchen. And he was a drummer, and he had all of the pots and the pans and all of this type of thing. He was a white drummer, tremendous. Jack Powell.
This was all on the vaudeville circuit, during the vaudeville days. And he -- I caught him a lot of times.
